delegatedAuditFamilies.name: Blog
delegatedAuditFamilies.reason: Blog content is generated/stored outside the static website estate and has its own audit pipeline.

delegatedAuditFamilies.name: Podcast transcripts
delegatedAuditFamilies.reason: Transcript content is generated/stored in R2 and has its own audit pipeline.

rules.title: Full live static and dynamic route inventory
rules.issueAnchor: Audit every live static and dynamic public-facing route
rules.acceptance: Every governed public route is tested for headings, landmarks, keyboard access, form behaviour and content flow; per-route results and exceptions are retained.

rules.title: Before/after screenshot and viewport inventory
rules.acceptance: Before/after images cover all representative templates, errors, consent states and 320/390/768/1440px; visual differences are compared and stored privately.

rules.title: Premium editorial UX and shared component review
rules.issueAnchor: Complete UX review of homepage content hierarchy
rules.acceptance: Homepage, navigation, editorial views, podcast and books have documented evaluated improvements, baseline and verified final result.

rules.title: Consent flows and mobile viewport obstruction
rules.acceptance: New-visitor, reject and customise flows pass at mobile viewports without obstructing content or breaking analytics/consent.

rules.title: WCAG 2.2 AA automated plus manual acceptance
rules.acceptance: Axe, keyboard, screen-reader, 200% zoom, contrast, focus and every seasonal/event palette are checked, with evidence and exceptions.

rules.title: Field and lab Core Web Vitals
rules.issueAnchor: Capture field and lab Core Web Vitals
rules.acceptance: Field 75th-percentile LCP, INP, CLS and laboratory measurements are recorded and compared with baseline, plus font/CSS findings.

rules.title: KDP format availability and purchase destinations
rules.acceptance: API-verified Kindle, paperback and hardback availability and working purchase URLs for all 40 governed titles are checked.

rules.title: R2 publishing, metadata and dynamic editorial templates
rules.acceptance: Dedicated R2 content audits attest published blog/transcript counts, metadata/schema, brand identity, image CLS and rendering on actual pages.

rules.title: Evidence-based scoring and remediation
rules.issueAnchor: Document benchmark evidence for each scored category
rules.acceptance: Each scored category has a benchmark, genuine evidence, severity, actionable remediation and verified reassessment; no unsupported 10/10 claims.

rules.title: Exact-head PR governance and post-deploy parity
rules.acceptance: Exact head SHA, required CI/trusted admission, Cloudflare production deployment and post-deploy live source parity are verified.

rules.title: All season and special-event visual regression
rules.acceptance: Every programmed date boundary, seasonal and special-event colour contrast, responsive layout and visual screenshot parity is covered.

rules.title: Weekly R2 blog sitemap publication parity
rules.acceptance: Live sitemap retains governed URLs and includes every published R2 blog article with valid canonical URL and publication date, refreshing after new weekly publications.
